name: Show of Force
label: Quest
description: Deputy Feldon sends you to drive gnoll packs back from Lakeshire. The Redridge guards need proof that the thrashers have been beaten.

clips.title: The story
paras: Deputy Feldon sends you to drive gnoll packs back from Lakeshire. The Redridge guards need proof that the thrashers have been beaten.

Gnoll packs have grown bolder in the Redridge Mountains. Their camps now lie close to Lakeshire and the human homesteads beyond it. Stormwind has too few soldiers to spare for the borderlands, so local authorities depend on travelers to hold the perimeter. The gnolls have not yet struck the town, but their camps bring them within reach of its homes.

Deputy Feldon knows the gnolls respect strength above all. He wants you to hunt their fiercest fighters, the gnoll thrashers, and bring back their spiked collars as proof of defeat. By breaking the front line and showing the trophies, Lakeshire's defenders hope to frighten the surviving packs into retreating to the highlands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them.

The beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.
Should you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!

clips.title: Completion
paras: While this doesn't solve our problem out here, I can rest comfortably knowing we've discouraged them pushing any further. Great work, friend.
